title: A Tesla Semi Caught Fire Without Crashing. Here's the Problem #shorts

scenes.text: An electric semi truck caught fire on a California freeway. And there was no crash.
It was a Tesla Semi, near Hayward, in late October. The driver got out unhurt, but part of the freeway stayed closed for about ten hours.
Battery fires are stubborn. One hot cell heats its neighbors, so the battery keeps feeding its own fire.
In twenty twenty-four, another Tesla Semi crashed and burned in the Sierra. Firefighters used about fifty thousand gallons of water.
To be fair, America sees about fifteen thousand big truck fires a year, mostly diesel. The cause of this one is still under investigation.
Rare, but harder to fight. Would you trust electric trucks on your highway? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
